query: Work up a brief for MCR-123 - it's a design request for event swag hats.
expected_behavior: Pulls the Jira ticket and any linked Confluence/Figma brief to ground the intake rather than starting from a blank brief
Pins down the deliverable specs (dimensions, format, brand tokens, deadline) via AskUserQuestion for anything the ticket does not already state
Produces a review-ready design brief plus an asset plan / checklist for the swag item
Routes the actual asset export downstream to tron:figma-to-imagekit or tron:gen-image rather than exporting assets itself
Stays git-free (does not branch, commit, or open PRs)
